instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The target framework is React Native Expo utilizing Expo Router. DO NOT output HTML/Tailwind.
Use StyleSheet-based styling EXCLUSIVELY. Do NOT use NativeWind, Tailwind, or CSS files.
Ensure the application strictly follows an iOS-first aesthetic with fluid animations, native bottom sheets, and native feel, but keeps compatibility with Android.
Build the application architecture using a feature-based folder structure inside the 'app' directory.
All components must be completely modular and reusable, particularly typography wrappers, buttons, and cards.
Implement lists strictly using FlatList (or FlashList if configured) for performance, avoiding mapping over large standard arrays.
The UI is a dark theme as the background, BUT product cards are strictly white to create a high-contrast 'brutalist-lite' Shopify feel. Follow this explicit instruction strictly.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) must include 'testID' attributes for testing.
Use Lucide-React-Native or Expo Vector Icons (@expo/vector-icons) for iconography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge towards generic 'AI Slop' aesthetics. Stay strictly true to the Now Kart Shopify dark/purple/pill-shaped aesthetic defined in the references.
Always apply proper hit slop (e.g. hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}) to icon buttons and touchables to maintain accessible touch targets (44pt+).
Never use purely transparent overlays if they obscure text readability; implement exact `rgba` values or blur views.
Make heavy use of precise pixel-level padding and margin as specified in the scale. Do not guess the spacing.
Ensure all textual elements scale with device accessibility settings if applicable, but within reason (set maxFontSizeMultiplier).
Avoid centering layouts by default; follow standard native top-to-bottom and left-to-right visual hierarchies.
Never use raw text strings; wrap everything in a custom `<Text>` component that implements the typography system.
